heading: Oracle layoffs reach Abilene, the 'flagship' Stargate data center that Oracle keeps showing as proof the OpenAI deal is fine: Employee says he found out he was fired when...
author: TOI Tech Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 11:34 IST
paragraphs: Oracle's layoffs on September 14 reached Abilene, Texas, the site the company has spent months holding up as evidence that its OpenAI partnership is on track

One employee there, an IC2 in OCI who says he joined on February 2, described the morning on r/employeesOfOracle: the termination email arrived at 5am Central, he did not see it, and he only realised what had happened when his badge failed at the gate
His last performance review had been "meets expectations"
Another poster in the same thread said Customer Hardware Support was cut at Abilene, Phoenix and Ashburn.Abilene is not an incidental site
It is the flagship Stargate campus, the one Oracle cites when it talks about 200MW of operational capacity and an eight-building build running on schedule
It is also the site OpenAI has decided not to expand, preferring clusters with newer Nvidia chips, and the one lenders declined to finance with Oracle as tenant
It leases the facility from Crusoe on a 15-year deal worth more than a billion dollars a year
Oracle has not commented on the cuts.Oracle employees lost Slack and VPN before the layoff email reached themThe sequence was the same everywhere
Federated logins stopped working around 4am Eastern, Slack sessions dropped out between 5am and 5.30am, and the email from "Oracle Leadership" landed at 6am
Several people on the subreddit said they were locked out before they could read it
One OCI employee wrote that his login let him in for a second, then booted him out

Another found out from a text sent by a coworker while he was walking home from a run.The posts ran through the morning across OCI security, CI/CD, enterprise engineering, observability, executive escalations, Fusion, NetSuite sales, Customer Success Services, Oracle Health, EPM, HR Technology and data centre compliance

Employees tracked the Slack member count as it fell, putting the US drop at roughly 3,200 against Friday.Oracle severance works out to 4 weeks plus a week for every year servedOracle is offering four weeks of base salary plus one additional week per year of service
The March version of the plan capped the total at 26 weeks
The latest documents do not state a cap.That formula explains the numbers circulating on Reddit
A data centre technician with eight months reported four weeks
Someone with four years in the database org got seven and called it a kick in the nuts

By comparison, Salesforce's standard policy runs up to 30 weeks and Microsoft offered up to 39 weeks this summer.Abilene shows what Oracle's AI buildout costs on both sides of the ledgerThe money behind Abilene is what makes the cuts there awkward
Oracle reported $28.5 billion in first-quarter capital expenditure, against $8.5 billion a year earlier, and kept its fiscal 2027 forecast at $90 billion to $95 billion

It raised its restructuring plan by about $700 million on Friday, to roughly $2.8 billion, and tied part of that to AI adoption across some functions.Headcount had already fallen by 21,000 in the year to May 31, leaving about 141,000 staff before September 14

One employee on the subreddit, writing from Abilene, put it more plainly than any filing: he had previously worked at IBM and Microsoft, so he would be fine, he just had to get out of town first.Get the latest technology news and updates
